capabilities: Run a focus timer on one task
Log timer sessions to a day calendar
Plan tasks on a day or week board
Track quests with stages and weekly hour targets
Save weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly reviews as notes
disambiguation: Not a game or RPG quest tracker; quests are long-term goals with stages, hour targets and weekly reviews.
extras: Works offline and makes no network requests; interface in English and German; modules can be switched off individually; notes stay readable if you go back to version 1.0.
problem: Task lists show everything still left to do but give no single focus, no record of where time went and no prompt to reflect.

relations.evidence: The task syntax is compatible with the Tasks plugin.
Inspired by Niklas Steenfatt's Quest app.

summary: Goal and task system with a one-task focus timer, time logs, done lists and weekly reviews, all stored as plain Markdown.
